title: One-Pot Brazilian Chicken Skewer Stew with Chimichurri Glaze
summary: Bringing churrasco-inspired flavors into a streamlined meal, this Brazilian skewer dish is adapted into an clever one-pot stew formula. Tender chicken thigh cubes, bell peppers, sausage rings, and sweet onions are threaded onto wooden skewers and seared right inside a wide Dutch oven. Once browned, the skewers simmer gently over a bed of spiced cassava, black beans, and rich chicken broth inside the same pot. A tangy homemade chimichurri glaze made with fresh parsley, oregano, garlic, and red wine vinegar is brushed over the hot skewers before serving. The result is juicy, flame-seared skewers resting over a comforting, flavorful bean and cassava reduction. Perfect for busy weeknights when you crave barbecue taste without heating an outdoor grill, this one-pot meal offers simplicity without sacrificing authenticity. Rich in lean muscle protein, high fiber, and bold herbal notes, it is sure to become a staple dinner favorite.

steps.step: Soak eight wooden bamboo skewers in water for fifteen minutes to prevent scorching.
Cut boneless chicken thighs into uniform one-inch square chunks on clean board.
Slice linguica sausage into half-inch thick rounds matching size of chicken pieces.
Cut red bell pepper and yellow onion into wide one-inch square pieces for skewering.
Thread chicken, pepper, sausage, and onion alternately onto soaked wooden skewers.
Season assembled skewers with smoked paprika, cumin, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Chop fresh parsley and fresh oregano finely for homemade chimichurri glaze mixture.
Mince garlic cloves finely and combine with chopped herbs in small ceramic bowl.
Whisk red wine vinegar, two tablespoons olive oil, red pepper flakes, and salt into herbs.
Set chimichurri glaze aside at room temperature so herb flavors infuse vinegar base.
Peel cassava root skin, remove woody core, and cut cassava into small half-inch cubes.
Rinse canned black beans in strainer under cool water and drain off excess liquid.
Dice fresh tomato finely on cutting board and set aside with drained black beans.
Ensure all skewer elements and stew ingredients are prepped before heating Dutch oven.
Heat one tablespoon olive oil and butter in wide Dutch oven over high flame until smoking.
Place four skewers into hot Dutch oven, searing three minutes until bottoms turn dark brown.
Flip skewers over using metal tongs and sear second side for three additional minutes.
Transfer seared skewers to plate and repeat searing process for remaining four skewers.
Add cubed cassava root and diced tomato to hot pan drippings remaining in Dutch oven.
Sauté cassava for three minutes until outer edges turn lightly golden and fragrant.
Pour chicken broth into Dutch oven, stirring to deglaze browned bits from pot bottom.
Add drained black beans and bay leaf to simmering broth cassava mixture in pot.
Arrange all eight seared skewers neatly on top of bubbling cassava and black bean bed.
Cover Dutch oven tightly with lid, reduce heat to low, and simmer for fifteen minutes.
Check chicken internal temperature with thermometer to confirm it reaches hundred sixty-five.
Check cassava cubes with fork to ensure they are soft and tender throughout inside.
Stir lime juice into bubbling black bean cassava stew base beneath skewers gently.
Remove pot from heat flame and let skewers rest inside warm covered Dutch oven three minutes.
Uncover Dutch oven carefully, allowing trapped steam to escape away from your face.
Brush half of prepared chimichurri glaze generously over hot skewers while still in pot.
Sprinkle farofa toasted cassava mix across top of skewers to add authentic Brazilian crunch.
Garnish pot contents with chopped green scallions for vibrant fresh color contrast.
Transfer two skewers onto each of four warm dinner plates using tongs carefully.
Spoon warm black bean and cassava stew base generously alongside skewers on each plate.
Drizzle remaining fresh chimichurri glaze directly over plated skewers right before service.
Serve immediately while skewers are hot and chimichurri herb aroma is bright.
Provide extra farofa in small bowl on table for guests desiring additional crunch.
Ensure skewers remain intact during transfer from pot to plate for good presentation.
Check balance of tart chimichurri vinegar sauce and savory chicken skewered meat.
Pair dish with cold Brazilian beverages or lime wedges for extra citrus bright finish.
Confirm all wooden skewers are handled safely as metal pot handles can retain high heat.
Enjoy vibrant one-pot Brazilian skewer feast packed with flame-seared herbs and spice.
